env_allowlist.PATH: inherited only for local Python, Git, Bash, Bubblewrap, Lake, Lean, and Elan discovery
env_allowlist.HOME: inherited only for the pinned Elan toolchain and canonical read-only Lake cache
env_allowlist.LANG: the nested Lean recipe fixes C.UTF-8

network_enforcement: The outer checker performs only local file, Git, and process checks and is policy-denied from network use; the nested Lean replay is additionally namespace-enforced with Bubblewrap --unshare-net. This provisional recipe does not claim namespace enforcement for the outer Python process.

expected_outputs.semantic_hash_policy: exact four-line fail-closed release reconciliation summary

scope_boundary: Fail-closed worker reconciliation over all 17 frozen obligation records plus a fresh target-scoped network-isolated trust-zero Lean replay of the 14 machine obligations through the root and named local proof declarations. Covered IDs are reconciliation subjects, not proof-closure credit; the three governance overlays receive negative-status checks only. The recipe cannot provide prerequisite master acceptance, node-specific evidence reconciliation, immutable clean empty-cache release evidence, independent review, distinct-runner verification, or theorem completion.
